cycle.precondition_if_stated: a canonicalised-STATE walk returns to S at gap 2 only if sign(v2) == sign(v1) (row repeat, probability ~1/R with an advancing counter) or v2 == 2S+v1 (mod q) in the negated case / v2 == -v1 or -2S-v1 in the non-negated case; v17/v18 step on the true point and canonicalise only the stored key, so no such return is claimed
cycle.source: cycle_channel_v16.json: MEASURED per-window loss at R=32/64/128 (structural R^-2 2.283e-13 + additive R^-1 1.510e-7); it does NOT rest on any unconditional 2-cycle identity

policy.record_fields: 32B canonical key || 20-bit trail || 108-bit step; no coefficients
policy.rule: every hit replays both trails from their stored identities; the replay decides triviality (da=db=0) and, if nontrivial, recovers x=-da/db; rejected hits are charged their own replay

addressing.decomposition: chunk = addr >> 40 (full 256-bit value, never masked); page = (addr>>20) & (2^20-1); byte = addr & (2^20-1); every field is consumed, so distinct addresses cannot share a location
addressing.readback: ext_read is the exact inverse; the control writes a record at 48*5 and at 48*(2^64+5) and reads each back from its own address (distinct_locations=1, readable_at_5=1, no_alias_at_2p64=1)

success.note: success = at least one coefficient-nontrivial collision that recovers x, measured per trial on the global store; useful_per_collision = 1.0 in every ladder cell, so the success event is witness existence
